rows.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice for wandering or roaming around without a specific destination.

example.english: I range around all day, so there’s no need to make plans with me.
example.traditional: 我成日周圍走，唔使特登約我。
example.jyutping: ngo5 seng4 jat6 zau1 wai4 zau2 m4 sai2 dak6 dang1 joek3 ngo5

rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose noun for the available options or variety of products and services.

example.english: This shop has a wide range of choices.
example.jyutping: ni1 gaan1 pou3 tau4 ge3 syun2 zaak6 hou2 do1

rows.note: Use this for a species or thing being naturally distributed across a geographical area.

example.english: This species can range across the southern coastal region.
example.traditional: 呢種雀分布喺南方沿海地區。
example.jyutping: ni1 zung2 zoek3 fan1 bou3 hai2 naam4 fong1 jyun4 hoi2 dei6 keoi1

rows.note: Use this for a person or animal living in a particular district, rather than for a geographical distribution.

example.english: These monkeys live in the New Territories, where they range freely.
example.jyutping: ni1 di1 hau4 zi2 zyu6 hai2 san1 gaai3

rows.note: Use this for the maximum distance a weapon can reach, especially in technical descriptions.

example.english: This rifle has a range of three kilometres.
example.traditional: 呢枝步槍嘅射程有三公里。
example.jyutping: ni1 zi1 bou6 coeng1 ge3 se6 cing4 jau5 saam1 gung1 lei5

rows.note: Use this specifically for a connected line or system of mountains.

example.english: This mountain range stretches for hundreds of kilometres.
example.traditional: 呢條山脈綿延幾百公里。
example.jyutping: ni1 tiu4 saan1 mak6 min4 jin4 gei2 baak3 gung1 lei5

rows.note: Use this for a vehicle's travel capacity before it needs refuelling or recharging.

example.english: This electric car has a very good range.
example.traditional: 呢架電動車嘅續航力好強。
example.jyutping: ni1 gaa3 din6 dung6 ce1 ge3 zuk6 hong4 lik6 hou2 koeng4
